title: Raku and Experimental Firing Workshops (Fall/Spring)
how_to_join: Watch the site or sign up for the email list to learn when dates are announced.
summary: LangWeil Studio offers experimental raku, naked raku, horsehair, and obvara firing workshops in fall and spring at their studio, with limited space. They can also travel to schools or groups to conduct custom workshops.
source_quote: We have raku, naked raku, horsehair, and obvara experimental firing workshops at our studio in fall and spring. Watch the site or sign up for our e mail list to be first to know dates when they are announced.
